question: Aman covers a distance of 15 km in 3 hours and a distance of 20 km in 2 hours. What is the average speed of Aman?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = 15 + 20 = 35 km

Total Time = 3 + 2 = 5 hours

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 35 ÷ 5 = 7 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 7 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance covered in 1st part = 15 km

Time taken for 1st part = 3 hours

Distance covered in 2nd part = 20 km

Time taken for 2nd part = 2 hours

 Total Distance = 35 km

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 15 km + 20 km = 35 km

⇒ Total Time = 3 hours + 2 hours = 5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 35 ÷ 5 = 7 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 7 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If two equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Equal Time

If a journey is covered at speeds x and y for equal time intervals, Average Speed = (x + y) ÷ 2.

Relative Speed

When moving in the same direction, relative speed = (x − y). When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = (x + y).
